name: Absorption product verifies second native deal after Palace escrow

condition.code:
local tx=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption).GetState().Transactions['native-product-return-probe']
local reads=ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroReadAPI
return tx and tx.NativeDealUI and reads and reads.GetObservation(tx.NativeDealUI.Token)~=nil

steps.code:
local A=assert(JAC_AbsorptionGameplay)
local id='native-product-return-probe'
local before=assert(A.GetState().Transactions[id])
local palace,returned
for _,work in ipairs(before.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Source.BuildingType=='BUILDING_PALACE' then palace=work
 elseif work.Custodian and work.Custodian~=before.To then returned=work end
end
assert(palace and returned and palace.PhysicalMoved and returned.DealSubmitted and before.NativeDealUI.Index==returned.Source.Index,'saved Palace proof or return intent absent')
local tx=A.Resume(id)
for _,work in ipairs(tx.NativeWorks or {}) do
 if work.Source.Index==palace.Source.Index then palace=work elseif work.Source.Index==returned.Source.Index then returned=work end
end
assert(palace.PhysicalMoved and returned.PhysicalMoved,'one of the two original native works was not physically proved')
local moved=0
for _,snap in ipairs(tx.Cities or {}) do local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(snap.X,snap.Y);if city and city:GetOwner()==tx.To then moved=moved+1 end end
print('[JAC_NATIVE_PRODUCT_BOTH_WORKS] palace='..palace.Source.Index..' return='..returned.Source.Index..' cities='..moved..'/'..#tx.Cities..' status='..tx.Status..' finalUI='..tostring(tx.AwaitingFinalUI))
return 'both native works physically proved; saved transaction '..tx.Status
